title: ATS vs. Recruiters: The Real Reason You're Not Getting Interviews
description:
ATS Isn't Rejecting Your CV. Recruiters Are.

Your CV isn't being rejected by an ATS. A human is, and they're doing it in 6 seconds. This video breaks the ATS myth (your CV goes into a database, not a filter), explains what's actually filtering you out (the knockout questions on the application form), and walks through the 3 things a real recruiter scans for in those 6 seconds: your job title sequence, company recognition, and one quantified result on every role.

If you've been optimising your CV for a Jobscan or Resume Worded score, you've been optimising for a number nobody at a real employer ever sees. Here's what they actually look at.

What you'll learn in this video:
- Why none of the 7 biggest ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Workday, Lever, Ashby) auto-reject your CV
- The knockout questions that filter you out before a human ever opens your file
- The 6-second scan recruiters run, and the 3 signals they hunt for
- How to fix your job title sequence so it reads as one clean story, not lateral confusion
- The exact quantified-result formula that moves your CV into the qualified pile
